entities.title: Lockstep
entities.summary: Browsers play the same steps, notice drift, and agree on who left.
criteria: Browsers play the same steps whatever the delays
A player who leaves plays on as null from the same step for everyone
Browsers notice when their games drift apart
The delay covers the slowest two players' connections

checks.symbol: browsers in lockstep play the same steps, whatever the delays
a player who leaves plays on as null from the same step for everyone
browsers notice when their games drift apart
the delay covers the slowest two players' connections

entities.details: The tests drive Lockstep over a stand-in room; the WebSocket, the games hub's relay and Shatterbelt's own messages (start, name, results) are not tested.

entities.title: Name rules
entities.summary: Names are cleaned to what the tables can show.
criteria: Accents are dropped and a few letters spelled out
Spaces are collapsed and the name cut to 12 characters
A name with no letter or digit, or not a string, is empty

checks.symbol: the server's helpers: names, submissions, and scores from the issued seed

entities.details: The scenes, the name form, the device's table, input, drawing and sound have no automated checks; they are tried by playing the built game in a browser.
